narr: Thunderstorms brought locally heavy rain to parts of central New Jersey from the late afternoon into the evening of July 15. Rainfall totals were as high as 3 to 5 inches.
ev: US Route 1 southbound was closed at Plainfield Avenue in Edison Township due to flooding.
Sections of US Route 9 in the Hopelawn area of Woodbridge Township became impassable due to flooding.
NJ Route 18 northbound near West Prospect Street in East Brunswick Township was closed due to flooding.
NJ Route 27 in Franklin Township was closed near Franklin Boulevard due to flooding.
NJ Route 29 near Duffield Drive in Ewing Township was closed due to flooding.
Jersey Avenue became impassable between Huron Road and Corporate Road in North Brunswick Township due to flooding. Two vehicles were trapped in the flood waters.
NJ Route 31 was impassable at West Delaware Avenue in Pennington due to flooding.
lsr: Much of Route 1 South in Edison is flooded. All lanes are closed. With a report of several stalled cars.
